content: The test image shows a corn leaf with long, elongated tan/straw-colored lesions running parallel to the leaf veins. The lesions are narrow and stripe-like. Top candidates: Gray Leaf Spot (rectangular lesions between veins) or Northern Leaf Blight (large cigar-shaped lesions).
